snippet.title: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
#ExtractionShooter #steam #PvPvE

🌒OFFMOON

BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE extraction shooter where animals raid the ruins of a world left behind by humanity! Explore zombie-infested streets and dangerous laboratories, scavenge valuable loot, and face off against hostile creatures and rival raiders. Go solo or team up, craft better gear, and upgrade your hideout to prepare for your next raid. Push deeper for bigger rewards—or escape with what you have. Just make sure you get out alive!

🎉The BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS demo is coming soon!
🔥We’re joining Steam Next Fest! Get ready to jump into the demo and experience the thrill of looting, fighting, and escaping!

✨Wishlist BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4867740/BEASTOPIA_RAIDERS/

🚨Planned Release Date: TBA🚨

https://discord.gg/wW5VjyEEAz

🎮STEAM:
